# Maturity ladder (`maturity-ladder` v1)

Contractual inflows and outflows by time bucket for one entity and currency, with the cumulative gap.

**Group:** Liquidity · **Mnemonic:** `MLAD` · **Identifiers:** `MLAD-…` in `ladderId`

Open one with `MLAD <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: maturity-ladder
version: 1
description: "Contractual inflows and outflows by time bucket for one entity and currency, with the cumulative gap."
match: { kind: maturity-ladder, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Liquidity · Maturity ladder, id: $.ladderId }
strip:
  - { label: Entity, bind: $.legalEntityName }
  - { label: Currency, bind: $.currency }
  - { label: Cumulative gap (1M), bind: $.gap1m, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Survival (days), bind: $.survivalDays, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: net
    kind: hbar
    title: Net flow by bucket
    code: GAP
    key: F2
    rows: $.buckets
    label: bucket
    value: net
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - id: buckets
    kind: table
    title: Buckets
    key: F3
    rows: $.buckets
    columns:
      - { label: Bucket, bind: "@.bucket" }
      - { label: Inflows, bind: "@.inflows", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Outflows, bind: "@.outflows", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Net, bind: "@.net", fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
      - { label: Cumulative, bind: "@.cumulative", fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
